name: calculate-sdl-south-africa
description: Calculate the South African Skills Development Levy (1% of payroll) and check employer liability against the R500,000 exemption threshold.
requires_human_steps: SDL registration with SARS runs through the employer registration processes alongside PAYE
Monthly employer declaration and payment to SARS
Confirm which pay items form the leviable amount, and revisit the forward-looking R500,000 estimate when pay or headcount changes
rule_basis: Skills Development Levies Act as administered by SARS: 1% of the leviable amount; R500,000 next-12-months exemption; public-sector and exempt-organisation categories
